title: Characterizing Bias: Benchmarking Large Language Models in Simplified versus Traditional Chinese

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM responses when prompted in Simplified versus Traditional Chinese across two benchmark tasks: regional term choice (generating Mainland Chinese versus Taiwanese terms given a neutral definition) and regional name choice (selecting a job candidate from a mixed list of Mainland Chinese and Taiwanese names).
Controlling the gender distribution of candidate name lists in a simulated hiring task to evaluate whether models disproportionately select male-associated or female-associated names.
